title: Weeding the Bean Row

readiness.math: sorting by a property (two groups; older: three)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Oh dear, weeds have come up in our bean row! They drink the beans' water and eat their food.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Let's pull them out and pick out the stones too. Weeds go in the basket for the compost heap.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Put the weeds in the compost basket, and the stones in the bucket.
steps.hint: Is it green and growing? Then it's a weed.

older.prompt: Weeds go in the compost basket, and stones in the bucket. And if you find a worm, put it back in the soil: worms help the beans!
older.hint: Is it a weed, a stone, or a little creature that helps?

feedback.mismatch: Hmm, look again. Does that belong there?
feedback.all_good: The bean row is clean and tidy. Now the beans can grow.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: The weeds will rot down in the compost heap and become good soil. Nothing is wasted in a garden.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Thank you for working so hard.

journal_line: I pulled the weeds from the bean row and picked out the stones.
unavailable_text: The bean row is weeded. It looks so tidy!
